fight-in-the-skies.evidence: Complete unchanged84page scanned TSR7008 Dawn Patrol boxed-set bundle, copyright1982, by Mike Carr, successfully retrieved from the relocated public archive. The named local Fight in the Skies summary explicitly includes the renamed1982seventh edition and its role-playing additions. The designer’s own FITS Society history independently identifies Dawn Patrol as the renamed, expanded1982edition of his1966Fight in the Skies and describes the earlier chain movement system. Cover/title/copyright/TOC and credits match; no BGG ID change or unrelated game substitution. Accepted scope is explicitly THIS1982SEVENTH EDITION, not a facsimile/certification of the1966,1972,1976or1979rules. Bundle contains original core basic rules,advanced rules,appendices,aircraft specifications,random-aircraft and combat/setup charts,critical-hit tables, scenarios,role-playing/pilot progression material,maneuver cards,counters,map scans and box covers. Entire basic core PDF5-16 read, plus advanced random setup/movement/turn outline,appendix point/mission/credits material and selected scenarios. Original covers/title/copyright/TOC,setup2,sequence3,firing/hit-location10,setup/collision12,advanced outline,scenario and selected aircraft/chart/counter/map images visually checked (PDF1-6,13,15,37,40-42,50,60,70,84among inspected pages). Core coverage includes scenario/team/aircraft/log setup,rolled movement order/altitude/tailing exceptions,normal and special movement, altitude/speed,range/field/target commitments,simultaneous firing,damage,ammunition,tailing/reversals,collisions,general combat ending and scenario victory. Source includes actual scenarios and numerical combat/aircraft aids,not merely an introductory overview or a software module requiring external rules. Existing text layer was absent on many pages and badly garbled on others; fresh forced English OCR was run on ALL84original PDF pages and kept separately from native text. OCR still misreads some numbers,table cells and diagrams,especially rotated charts and map/counter sheets. Original images govern exact values, maneuver geometry and cell alignment; no invented chart reconstruction or clean playable component set is certified. Advanced optional rules,all scenarios,all aircraft statistics and campaign/award details have not each been independently audited. One specific summary MAJOR movement-order finding is recorded against its explicitly included seventh-edition scope; no full summary audit,PASS,body repair or claim that every historical edition was checked.

It explicitly says its league rewrote the1982FASA rulebook in1984 and links a new2002campaign-oriented group at gravball.com. The archive request for that domain resolved to an actual2013HugeDomains parked-domain sale page, not rules. The league page itself supplies historical teams/results and contact text, not original12page setup/action/ending rules. No contact message was sent, no parked-domain purchase/captcha link was followed, and no league rewrite or Traveller/StarWars sport was substituted for the FASA game. Ordinary current Mongoose forum GETs resolved to challenge pages rather than posts; these are classified as failures despiteHTTP200, and no challenge was solved. Public connected-reader post text supplied the Earthlink lead only. Earlier domain captures/other original-manual hosts remain unexhausted.
